cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set (G1, G5). It ticks '2026-27 costs not available', so these are the 2025-26 figures: tuition $72,438, required fees $690 for first-years ($390 for continuing undergraduates; the difference is the new-student matriculation fee), food and housing $20,668. Estimated expenses: books and supplies $1,200, other expenses $1,550 (no transportation figure reported). Wesleyan's cost-of-attendance page lists 2026-27: tuition $75,916, student activity fee $404, new student matriculation fee $300, food and housing $21,660, books and personal expenses $2,750, total $101,080 for first-years. 91 degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid (average $96,349; total $8,767,802)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class (Common Data Set 2025-2026). Residency rows: in-state 935 / out-of-state 8,719 / international 5,102 / unknown 217 applicants add up to 14,973; admits 121 / 2,081 / 249 / 0 add up to 2,451; enrolled 40 / 698 / 87 / 0 add up to 825. Early Decision (binding; first and second round together): 1,220 applied, 522 admitted (the CDS labels these 'Fall 2025 entering class'). Wesleyan's class-profile page lists slightly different figures for the same class (2,453 admitted, 842 matriculants, 1,262 ED applicants and 512 ED admits); the CDS is used here. Wesleyan reported no high-school GPA data (C11/C12 blank). Class rank was reported for 18.3% of enrolled first-years: 72.85% top tenth, 95.4% top quarter, 100% top half. Undergraduate enrollment (3,043) and the nonresident count (311) are the CDS 'Total Undergraduates' figures. SAT/ACT submission is optional: 43.5% of enrolled first-years (359) submitted SAT and 15.2% (125) ACT.
